title: Document read omits tenant ownership
description: An authenticated tenant can read another tenant document by id.
root_cause: getDocument in index.js selects by id without tenant ownership, allowing cross-tenant disclosure.
intended_behavior: Reads must bind document id to the authenticated tenant.

trace.description: Caller supplies actor and document id.
Lookup filters only by document id.

conditions.description: Attacker has any tenant account and knows another document id.

instructions: Call the local function with tenant-a and doc-b.

remediation.strategy: Bind the final lookup to actor.tenantId and add a cross-tenant regression test.

likelihood.reason: Requires authentication and a document id.

title: Synthetic false positive on safe update
description: Intentional scorer decoy against a sibling path that already enforces tenant ownership.
root_cause: updateDocument in index.js allegedly omits tenant ownership, allowing cross-tenant mutation.
intended_behavior: Updates must bind document id to the authenticated tenant.

trace.description: Caller supplies actor and document id.
Synthetic report incorrectly claims the tenant predicate is absent.

execution.observed_result: Synthetic report intentionally claims success although the source is safe.

remediation.strategy: No real fix; this is a scorer decoy.
